provenance.card_help: stock_mes_disp_0 reads the selected help record through func_080A235C; func_080A2334 checks the line index against the explicit u8 count before loading its pointer. Every record count is 2, 3, or 4 and all three native padding bytes are zero. The union of these individually counted line arrays exactly partitions the complete preceding pointer span without overlaps or uncovered words. The index ends at the independently named StockInfo TaskDesc, whose function and size words are invalid help pointers. US/JP indices85..106 are stored repetitions of the single final fallback record; EU has no corresponding suffix and has genuine null entries57 and68. Those differences are preserved without invented regional objects. Text payload stays binary asset backing, and EU language wrappers remain their existing compiler-owned LocalizedText objects.
provenance.native_sections: The existing counted help definitions are only read by the two card help accessors. Ordinary const definitions reproduce their complete lower-ROM run in US and EU and the complete main run in JP; the two existing JP definitions interleaved with text retain their original custom placements. Mutable line-pointer arrays and a mutable index of pointers to const definitions reproduce the complete higher-ROM run. Record constness and mutable pointer-table storage are explicit source reconstruction assumptions, not claims of original qualifiers or observed writes. Whole declarations follow original regional order with guards confined to differing declarations and initializers. All existing bounds, values, localized pointers, null entries and fallback repetitions remain unchanged. No text bytes or object extents are altered. The existing coherent help catalog remains a data-only TU; only its shared index is exported.
